first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. HM Land Registry's unused public National Polygon Dataset technical specification defines the target-capable mandatory fields Shape, Poly_ID and Title_No and explains the title-number relationship to index polygons, but the full National Polygon Dataset requires an account, signed licence and payment and this public/no-login specification window contains no Forge Cottage target record. The specification also states that index polygons are indicative and may be larger or smaller than the title-plan extent, so they are not exact registered-title boundaries. Local OpenCode or authorised HM Land Registry access must bind the exact target title/polygon and canonical bbox; after that, bind one unused exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to that bbox.
exact_blocker: The method was materially changed from the VOA Council Tax public postcode/address search to HM Land Registry's National Polygon Dataset technical specification and data-model/access channel. The official page is public/no-login and identifies the precise machine-readable fields needed for target binding, but the target dataset itself is account/licence/payment gated and no Forge Cottage Title_No, Poly_ID or Shape is exposed in this window. No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is asserted; spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
